category: Bhaashaabhedam (register: Sanskritic and native, familiar and respectful)
label: the native word narrowed into narrative or literary use
note: The only two lessons in the corpus marked register: literary-narrative and literary. Both teach a native word that the everyday Sanskrit one displaced -- naal beside divasam, iravu beside raathri. A learner needs to recognise them and should not produce them, and the corpus marks that.
